glenn: 27 Oct 10:51 pm: ‘BEASTY • Chef’ with a screenshot of Instagram @chefsmelly (Edward’L, verified, 192K followers, category Restaurant; located inside @aulounge, Wed–Sun 1–9pm; 2430 Broadway, Oakland; order.store link and 3 more; Threads chefsmelly; Facebook Edward Wooley; highlights include ‘San Jose’).
flags: 135 items from his order.store page, over the 80 cap: the whole menu kept; the page gives no descriptions, so every description is empty.

Menu cleanup: his ‘Specials’ section dropped (all 7 items repeat other sections); ‘Smellys Wings Sweet And Spicy’ and a second ‘Hot Honey Chili Chicken Over Noodles’ removed from Land, ‘Chicken And Steak Fries’ kept only under Designer Fries; ‘Creole Loaded Fries’ left out (priced by add-ons, $0 base); ‘Creole Loaded Prawn Noodles’ appears twice at $40 and $35 with no difference given, both kept.
Item names are his own spelling (Blackend, Beat Arugula, Noddles, Beens, Lobtail, Al Acarte); not corrected.
Hours differ by source: Instagram bio Wed–Sun 1–9pm (used; matches Glenn’s screenshot); OpenTable Tue–Sun 1–9pm; the order.store page lists Mon–Fri 1–8:30pm, Sat–Sun 1–7:30pm (ordering hours).
Same door as the existing Au Lounge seed (au-lounge, 2430 Broadway), whose phone is 510.893.1411; his own number (510) 812-2675 is from the order.store page and OpenTable.
No website of his own: site is the order.store page (OpenTable’s ‘restaurant’s website’ link points there too). No email found.
Catering is from his OpenTable listing only (‘We cater to all events’); no catering menu or prices. No private-chef work found.
LOGO: no logo; the picture is a photo of him with a young girl beside him (probably family). Saved the 320px Threads copy; consider cropping to him alone or a wordmark before use.
‘San Jose’ story highlight not viewable without signing in; no San Jose location found. Older press mentions a planned brick-and-mortar at 10801 Bancroft Ave (undated); not used.
